model_annotation: Figure 4 presents trends in employment rates for immigrants arriving in Germany between 2010 and 2019, categorized by time since immigration. The x-axis represents the years since immigration, labeled linearly from 0 to 10 years, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis represents the employment rate as a percentage, ranging from 0 to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing the employment rate of all immigrants, a dashed orange line representing the employment rate of immigrants with a migration background, and a dotted green line representing the employment rate of immigrants without a migration background. The solid blue line begins at approximately 20% at 0 years and increases to approximately 70% at 10 years. The dashed orange line starts at approximately 30% at 0 years, rises to a peak of approximately 75% at 6 years, and then decreases slightly to approximately 70% at 10 years. The dotted green line begins at approximately 40% at 0 years, increases to approximately 80% at 5 years, and then plateaus around 80-85% for the remaining years.
